title: Corkboard
blurb: Coordinate canvas whose cards come from floaty directives in a text file
note: McCorkboard open projects samples/floaty.md: the demo's cards come from floaty directives in that file, not from anything hard coded, so editing the file changes the demo. McCorkboard openExample is the older free-coordinate board. McFloaty reads headings with McMarkdownParser, which is why the markdown chain is loaded here in the same order rich-edit needs it.
